items.task: Create a real-life situation that uses fractions as equal parts of a whole. Record the quantities and explain your reasoning.
Find one example at home/school of fraction pieces and making a whole. Draw or photograph the representation and label it.
Design a pair activity for equivalent fractions. Each partner must explain the answer in a different way.
Collect two measurements or observations connected to comparing fractions and compare them.
Make a small poster teaching fractions on number lines to a younger learner. Include one worked example.
Invent a challenge based on fractions relative to 1 and 1/2; exchange it with a classmate and check the solution.
